_comment_rewrites: API/media proxying to the Spring Boot backend is configured in next.config.js's rewrites() function, NOT here. vercel.json's own 'rewrites' field only accepts a hardcoded literal destination string - it cannot read an environment variable - so a '$API_ORIGIN'-style placeholder in this file would silently never resolve. next.config.js's rewrites() runs on the server per-request and reads process.env.API_ORIGIN, which you set once in the Vercel project's Environment Variables settings (and in .env.local for local dev). That is what actually keeps the browser same-origin and avoids CORS.
